system.description:
You launch a burst of your choice of weapons around yourself, attempting to hit all creatures surrounding you. All Creatures in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on you must succeed a Dexterity saving throw, taking your [Weapons damage] and are Dazed on a failed save, and half as much damage and no additional effects on a successful one.

Chain 1: A creature that fails their save has their movement speed reduced by 10 until the end of their next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d6.
